generation_parents.algorithm: Use a nearest-neighbor base rule, but when leaving the depot choose a deterministic first customer, and otherwise blend current-to-candidate distance with depot-savings and a bounded capacity-fill term to prefer route-coherent feasible customers.

The heuristic ranks each feasible customer by a blend of nearest-neighbor distance from the current node and depot savings, with a deterministic explicit start at the depot and a mild capacity-utilization tie-breaking term, while always returning a feasible customer when one exists.
